title: CNN Excluded From Air Force One as White House Escalates Media Access Restrictions
detail: CNN was left off the Air Force One press pool for President Trump's upcoming presidential trip, marking an escalation of the White House's media access restrictions. The move signals a broader effort to limit coverage from outlets the administration has publicly branded as adversarial, following the banning of CNN, MSNBC, and Politico reporters from the White House in September 2026.

media.caption: CNN excluded from Air Force One press pool as White House escalates media access restrictions

title: Trump Administration Works to Reshape Electoral Rules Ahead of 2026 Midterms
detail: The Trump administration is pursuing efforts to reshape electoral rules to its advantage ahead of the November 2026 midterm elections, according to a Le Monde analysis. The moves include initiatives on voter registration, election administration, and rules governing federal races that critics say are designed to benefit Republican candidates in the upcoming midterms.

title: Trump Rejects Iran's Seven-Day Ceasefire Proposal, Tells Aides He Expects to Resume Bombing After Midterms
detail: President Trump has rejected a seven-day ceasefire proposal from Iran and told aides he expects US bombing of Iran to resume after the November midterm elections, the Wall Street Journal reported Saturday, September 26, 2026, citing US officials. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's plan, floated through Qatari mediation, offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, resume nuclear talks and observe regional ceasefires in exchange for the US lifting its Gulf of Oman naval blockade, waiving sanctions on Iranian oil sales and unfreezing assets. The proposal followed a roughly three-hour, Qatar-mediated meeting between US envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump son-in-law Jared Kushner and Iranian officials that Secretary of State Marco Rubio said 'did not produce a breakthrough' but was 'significant' for occurring at all. Officials said Trump is privately skeptical Tehran will meet US terms, is reluctant to resume major combat operations, and that the scope of any renewed strikes remains undefined — with his ultimate decision described as likely to hinge as much on the outcome of the midterms as on developments in the six-month-old war.

media.caption: President Trump, who rejected Iran's seven-day ceasefire proposal and told aides he expects to resume bombing after the midterms, pictured at a White House tea with Xi Jinping the day before
